summary: 7 hours of music, household and outdoor sounds and speech in other languages, with no wake word, for every Aragonese wake-word detector. A detector streams every recording, and the board ranks it on how often per hour it woke, with a column for each kind of audio.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py: the `negatives-an-ES` part of OpenVoiceOS/ww-stream-bench. The negatives hold 1 h of music, 1 h of household and outdoor sounds, 5 h of speech in other languages: 7 hours in all. Its sources and their licences are in the dataset card.
